summary: In this excerpt from Book 4 (part 41), Anda returns to an online game after almost a month locked out of her PC by her dad, during which she was on medication, cut off from TV and gaming, and miserable at school. She rejoins her squad leader, Lucy (called Sarge), at a noisy gaming hall called the Baang, and they rapidly clear four missions with the BFG10K. Anda then raises a noob named Raymond, a self-described union organizer, and Lucy confronts her about the ethics of the cottage workers' wages.
one_line: Anda returns to an online game after a month-long ban, clears missions with Sarge, and clashes over a union organizer's claims about cottage noobs.
key_facts: Anda has been locked out of her PC for almost a month and is kept under lock-and-key in her dad's study.
During the ban Anda was on medications, had no telly and no gaming, and attended double PE periods at school with the other whales.
Anda's only pleasures after school were trips to the newsagents at the 501-meter mark and eating sweets and fizzy drink in the park while watching the chavs play football.
Anda plays at the Baang, a PC gaming hall filled with loud, stinky spotty boys who smell like goats.
Anda calls her squad leader Sarge, and Sarge tells her she is too good to replace.
Sarge has a backlog of missions and says they can do four missions that day using the BFG10K.
One BFG10K bolt is made up of 20 regular BFG bolts, each costing a small fortune in gold.
The pair start with five BFG10K bolts and use them all on the first three targets.
After returning the BFG10K to the armory, they take a couple of BFGs and head for the fourth target.
Anda says she met a noob in the cottage after the last campaign, a man who said he was a union organizer.
Sarge says she also met Raymond, that he has been turning up everywhere, and calls him a creep.
Anda admits she figured out the noobs in the cottages mostly on her own, and Raymond told her a little more.
Lucy asks Anda, in a brittle voice, whether she is fine with depriving little kids of their wages.
Anda worries that her position may have been usurped by another girl while she was locked off the game.
